changeSet.comment: nexus-bbtc2: text_gate_probe_384/768/1024 gain a third statement for the caller's transaction-local GUC nexus.lexical_trgm = 'substring': the gate is the FTS half OR an exact substring match, case-folded by ILIKE, of the gate text (ILIKE with \ % _ escaped), which the trigram GIN prunes, in place of word_similarity. The engine sets 'substring' for a one-token gate text. 'off' and the default keep vectors-057's statements. Same signatures, return type, owner, grants and security posture (read back as vectors-057-1 does). No data effect: function definitions only.

m.collection, m.chash FROM nexus.catalog_document_chunks m JOIN nexus.catalog_documents d ON d.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND d.tumbler = m.doc_id JOIN nexus.chunks c ON c.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND c.collection = m.collection AND c.chash = m.chash CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT nexus.catalog_source_format(d.content_type, d.file_path) AS fmt ) f CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT (jsonb_build_object( 'section_title', CASE WHEN nexus.manifest_names_key(p_manifest_where, p_manifest_path, 'section_title') THEN CASE WHEN m.labels_written THEN to_jsonb(COALESCE(m.section_title, '')) ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(c.metadata -> 'section_title', 'null'::jsonb), '""'::jsonb) END END, 'section_type', CASE WHEN nexus.manifest_names_key(p_manifest_where, p_manifest_path, 'section_type') THEN CASE WHEN m.labels_written THEN to_jsonb(COALESCE(m.section_type, '')) ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(c.metadata -> 'section_type', 'null'::jsonb), '""'::jsonb) END END, 'page_number', CASE WHEN nexus.manifest_names_key(p_manifest_where, p_manifest_path, 'page_number') THEN CASE WHEN m.labels_written THEN COALESCE(to_jsonb(m.page_number), '""'::jsonb) ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(c.metadata -> 'page_number', 'null'::jsonb), '""'::jsonb) END END, 'title', CASE WHEN nexus.manifest_names_key(p_manifest_where, p_manifest_path, 'title') THEN CASE WHEN d.title ~ '\S' THEN to_jsonb(d.title) ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(c.metadata -> 'title', 'null'::jsonb), '""'::jsonb) END END, 'source_author', CASE WHEN nexus.manifest_names_key(p_manifest_where, p_manifest_path, 'source_author') THEN CASE WHEN COALESCE(d.author, '') ~ '\S' THEN to_jsonb(d.author) ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(c.metadata -> 'source_author', 'null'::jsonb), '""'::jsonb) END END, 'bib_doi', CASE WHEN nexus.manifest_names_key(p_manifest_where, p_manifest_path, 'bib_doi') THEN to_jsonb(d.bib_doi) END, 'bib_openalex_id', CASE WHEN nexus.manifest_names_key(p_manifest_where, p_manifest_path, 'bib_openalex_id') THEN to_jsonb(d.bib_openalex_id) END, 'bib_semantic_scholar_id', CASE WHEN nexus.manifest_names_key(p_manifest_where, p_manifest_path, 'bib_semantic_scholar_id') THEN to_jsonb(d.bib_semantic_scholar_id) END, 'content_type', CASE WHEN nexus.manifest_names_key(p_manifest_where, p_manifest_path, 'content_type') THEN to_jsonb(array_remove(ARRAY[ CASE WHEN d.content_type ~ '\S' THEN d.content_type END, f.fmt, CASE WHEN f.fmt IS NULL OR NOT (COALESCE(d.content_type, '') ~ '\S') THEN COALESCE(c.metadata ->> 'content_type', '') END ], NULL)) END, 'tags', CASE WHEN nexus.manifest_names_key(p_manifest_where, p_manifest_path, 'tags') THEN CASE WHEN p_manifest_path IS NOT NULL AND position('"tags"' in p_manifest_path) > 0 THEN nexus.catalog_tag_set(CASE WHEN COALESCE(jsonb_typeof(d.metadata -> 'tags'), 'null') <> 'null' THEN d.metadata -> 'tags' ELSE c.metadata -> 'tags' END) ELSE '[""]'::jsonb END END, 'category', CASE WHEN nexus.manifest_names_key(p_manifest_where, p_manifest_path, 'category') THEN CASE WHEN COALESCE(jsonb_typeof(d.metadata -> 'category'), 'null') <> 'null' THEN d.metadata -> 'category' ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(c.metadata -> 'category', 'null'::jsonb), '""'::jsonb) END END, 'ttl_days', CASE WHEN nexus.manifest_names_key(p_manifest_where, p_manifest_path, 'ttl_days') THEN CASE WHEN COALESCE(jsonb_typeof(d.metadata -> 'ttl_days'), 'null') <> 'null' THEN d.metadata -> 'ttl_days' ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(c.metadata -> 'ttl_days', 'null'::jsonb), '""'::jsonb) END END, 'source_agent', CASE WHEN nexus.manifest_names_key(p_manifest_where, p_manifest_path, 'source_agent') THEN CASE WHEN COALESCE(jsonb_typeof(d.metadata -> 'source_agent'), 'null') <> 'null' THEN d.metadata -> 'source_agent' ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(c.metadata -> 'source_agent', 'null'::jsonb), '""'::jsonb) END END, 'extraction_method', CASE WHEN nexus.manifest_names_key(p_manifest_where, p_manifest_path, 'extraction_method') THEN CASE WHEN COALESCE(jsonb_typeof(d.metadata -> 'extraction_method'), 'null') <> 'null' THEN d.metadata -> 'extraction_method' ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(c.metadata -> 'extraction_method', 'null'::jsonb), '""'::jsonb) END END, 'quality_gate_overridden', CASE WHEN nexus.manifest_names_key(p_manifest_where, p_manifest_path, 'quality_gate_overridden') THEN CASE WHEN COALESCE(jsonb_typeof(d.metadata -> 'quality_gate_overridden'), 'null') <> 'null' THEN d.metadata -> 'quality_gate_overridden' ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(c.metadata -> 'quality_gate_overridden', 'null'::jsonb), '""'::jsonb) END END, 'extraction_source', CASE WHEN nexus.manifest_names_key(p_manifest_where, p_manifest_path, 'extraction_source') THEN CASE WHEN COALESCE(jsonb_typeof(d.metadata -> 'extraction_source'), 'null') <> 'null' THEN d.metadata -> 'extraction_source' ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(c.metadata -> 'extraction_source', 'null'::jsonb), '""'::jsonb) END END, 'frecency_score', CASE WHEN nexus.manifest_names_key(p_manifest_where, p_manifest_path, 'frecency_score') THEN CASE WHEN COALESCE(jsonb_typeof(d.metadata -> 'frecency_score'), 'null') <> 'null' THEN d.metadata -> 'frecency_score' ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(c.metadata -> 'frecency_score', 'null'::jsonb), '""'::jsonb) END END ) || CASE WHEN nexus.manifest_names_key(p_manifest_where, p_manifest_path, 'bib_year') OR nexus.manifest_names_key(p_manifest_where, p_manifest_path, 'bib_authors') OR nexus.manifest_names_key(p_manifest_where, p_manifest_path, 'bib_venue') OR nexus.manifest_names_key(p_manifest_where, p_manifest_path, 'bib_citation_count') OR nexus.manifest_names_key(p_manifest_where, p_manifest_path, 'indexed_at') OR nexus.manifest_names_key(p_manifest_where, p_manifest_path, 'content_type_shown') THEN jsonb_build_object( 'bib_year', CASE WHEN nexus.manifest_names_key(p_manifest_where, p_manifest_path, 'bib_year') THEN CASE WHEN COALESCE(d.bib_year, 0) <> 0 THEN to_jsonb(d.bib_year) ELSE '""'::jsonb END END, 'bib_authors', CASE WHEN nexus.manifest_names_key(p_manifest_where, p_manifest_path, 'bib_authors') THEN to_jsonb(COALESCE(d.bib_authors, '')) END, 'bib_venue', CASE WHEN nexus.manifest_names_key(p_manifest_where, p_manifest_path, 'bib_venue') THEN to_jsonb(COALESCE(d.bib_venue, '')) END, 'bib_citation_count', CASE WHEN nexus.manifest_names_key(p_manifest_where, p_manifest_path, 'bib_citation_count') THEN CASE WHEN (d.bib_enriched_at IS NOT NULL OR COALESCE(d.bib_year, 0) <> 0 OR COALESCE(d.bib_citation_count, 0) <> 0 OR COALESCE(d.bib_authors, '') <> '' OR COALESCE(d.bib_venue, '') <> '' OR COALESCE(d.bib_semantic_scholar_id, '') <> '' OR COALESCE(d.bib_openalex_id, '') <> '' OR COALESCE(d.bib_doi, '') <> '') THEN to_jsonb(COALESCE(d.bib_citation_count, 0)) ELSE '""'::jsonb END END, 'indexed_at', CASE WHEN nexus.manifest_names_key(p_manifest_where, p_manifest_path, 'indexed_at') THEN CASE WHEN d.indexed_at IS NOT NULL THEN to_jsonb(to_char(d.indexed_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"+00:00"')) ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(c.metadata -> 'indexed_at', 'null'::jsonb), '""'::jsonb) END END, 'content_type_shown', CASE WHEN nexus.manifest_names_key(p_manifest_where, p_manifest_path, 'content_type_shown') THEN to_jsonb(CASE WHEN f.fmt IS NOT NULL THEN f.fmt WHEN d.content_type ~ '\S' THEN d.content_type ELSE COALESCE(c.metadata ->> 'content_type', '') END) END ) ELSE '{}'::jsonb END) AS eff ) e WHERE m.tenant_id = p_tenant AND m.collection = ANY(p_collections) AND c.embedding_model = p_embedding_model AND d.deleted_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM nexus.catalog_document_chunks sm JOIN nexus.catalog_documents sd ON sd.tenant_id = sm.tenant_id AND sd.tumbler = sm.doc_id WHERE p_exclude_sensitive IS NOT FALSE AND sm.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND sm.collection = c.collection AND sm.collection = ANY(p_collections) AND sm.chash = c.chash AND sd.deleted_at IS NULL AND sd.sensitive) AND (p_where IS NULL OR c.metadata @> p_where) AND (p_where_path IS NULL OR c.metadata @@ p_where_path::jsonpath) AND (p_query_text IS NULL OR c.chunk_tsv @@ plainto_tsquery('english', p_query_text) OR p_query_text OPERATOR(nexus.<%) c.chunk_text) AND (p_manifest_where IS NULL OR e.eff @> p_manifest_where) AND (p_manifest_path IS NULL OR e.eff @@ p_manifest_path::jsonpath) LIMIT p_cap $function$;
